title: 7.6 What I Like to Do
unit_outcome: Talk about the body, feelings, clothes, the weather and seasons, free time and invitations, ask people to repeat or speak slowly, and name things outdoors, animals, sports and music in Spanish.
goal: Say what you like to do: Me gusta bailar. ¿Te gusta tomar fotos? Sí, me gusta.
grammar_function: Me gusta + infinitive; ¿Te gusta + infinitive? Sí, me gusta. / No, no me gusta.
speaking_outcome: Say what you like to do: Me gusta bailar. ¿Te gusta tomar fotos? Sí, me gusta.
